title: Auckland · Coromandel Peninsula Loop
slogan: A 295 km loop out of Thames fuel
story: Sea, forest and tight Kiwi touring roads. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 118 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Whitianga beach, Kauaeranga valley, while Thames fuel and Coromandel town keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

sections.advice: Use Auckland start → Thames fuel (86 km) as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: Coromandel town → Whitianga beach (22 km) is the reward section in Auckland. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

sections.advice: This Whitianga beach → Kauaeranga valley stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Coromandel Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 58 km this is Coromandel Peninsula Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
